task_description: Add a product publish/unpublish status to the 4astore-v2 e-commerce app. Products get a status of draft|published. New products default to draft and are hidden from the storefront; the public catalog returns only published products. The admin UI gets a per-row Publish/Unpublish button and a status badge. Publishing is blocked (server-authoritative, HTTP 422) when required fields (name, price>0, category, image) are missing. Follows the repo's ADD-only / no-migrate runtime-column convention (ensure*Column raw SQL), mirrors max_qty_per_order. The public leakage test must stay green.
